 Community Watchlist Portfolio Search stocks, sectors, indices or pages News Tax Quick read FBR to launch online tax refund system for exporters in December
 Profit by Pakistan Today • 18 Nov 2026, 12:19 PM PKT • 1 min read 
 ENG اردو A- A+ Add as preferred source on Google X f FBR plans to begin handling exporters’ outstanding tax refund requests through a digital platform in December, Chairman Rashid Mahmood Langrial said at a Lahore Chamber of Commerce and Industry meeting on Tuesday. The service will accept supporting papers online and set time limits for resolving claims; Langrial said refunds issued this year would exceed last year’s total by 30%.
 FBR will also open an online hearing facility in Lahore for customs valuation disputes, so importers can present cases locally rather than travel to Karachi. The chairman said a senior official would hold hearings each day on complaints about valuation rates, and that the tax authority would consider giving Lahore’s Director of Customs Valuation greater powers. He also said FBR was willing to review concerns about the fixed tax scheme and cited support measures for small and medium-sized businesses.
 At a glance
 FBR expects this year’s refunds to be 30% higher than last year’s.
 An online refund platform for exporters is planned for December.
 A Lahore-based virtual hearing service will address customs valuation disputes.
 Why it matters
 The refund platform and customs dispute measures concern exporters, importers and businesses managing tax claims and valuation cases.
